tokens.json.becomes: adopted: the kernel's tokens, by the same hash; canvas passes dropped

revisions.becomes: adopted: card versions as history at negative revisions

pairing.json.becomes: dropped: a pairing code lives ten minutes

trash.becomes: kept: the folder deck's trash is .decks/trash

migrations.json.becomes: kept: the deck's version record, read and moved on by upgrade

agents.becomes: adopted: each agent's meta.json into people's store (upgrade 0.6.0)

authors.json.becomes: to confirm: who last wrote each card

heights.json.becomes: to confirm: each card's fitted height

seen.json.becomes: to confirm: what each agent last saw

canvases.becomes: to confirm: a canvas's settings from before canvases had folders

apps.becomes: to confirm: an app's log and built marker

thumbs.becomes: to confirm: card pictures, a cache

studio.json.becomes: to confirm: the Studio connection and its key

studio-sync.json.becomes: to confirm: what was last synced with Studio

studio-hashes.json.becomes: to confirm: the hashes Studio last had

sync.becomes: to confirm: friends' canvases as last synced
